meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能调用语言服务器工具来检查代码错误、定位定义、查找引用、列出符号,并安全执行重命名。
howto.when: 当需要代码诊断、定义等,或进行安全重命名时触发。

say.text: 检查一下这个文件的代码错误
say.note: 会返回该文件的 LSP 诊断结果
会定位并跳到符号定义处

say.text: 查找这个变量的所有引用
say.note: 会列出工作区中该符号的所有使用位置

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use language-server tools to check code errors, find definitions, search references, list symbols, and safely perform renames.
howto.when_en: Triggered when code diagnostics, definitions, or safe renames are needed, etc.

say_en.text: Check this file for code errors
say_en.note: Returns LSP diagnostics for the file

say_en.text: Jump to the definition of this function
say_en.note: Locates and jumps to the symbol definition

say_en.text: Find all references to this variable
say_en.note: Lists all usages of the symbol in the workspace
